title: Drop Files Or Images Here (They'll Be Added)
style: ambient electronic, glitchy textures, female whispered lead, male spoken word, 84 BPM, drone synths, paper rustle, ASMR percussion, melancholy, atmospheric, dropbox-decay, hypnotic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Drop files or images here, they'll be added
To the thread that's already locked and padded
The conversation ended but the dropzone stays
A ghost of a feature in the silent days

[Pre-Chorus]
Upload to nowhere, upload to nothing
The receiver disconnected, but you keep stuffing

[Chorus]
Drop files or images here
They'll be added to the void, my dear
Drop files or images here
No one's reading, no one's near

[Verse 2]
PNG, JPEG, PDF, DOC
Feed the dead chat with everything you've got
The little plus sign still hovers in blue
Like it doesn't know the team is through

[Bridge]
Receiving a lot more messages than usual
Thanks for your patience, the loop is residual
If you need immediate help, click the question mark
The help center icon glowing in the dark

[Outro]
Drop files or images here, they'll be archived
Filed in the cabinet where the threads have died
